section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations, strengths, and conclusions of the present study. Limitations include its correlational nature, limited scope of cosmetic enhancements measure, and generalizability issues due to a specific sample of 261 psychology students from a non-residential college in the northeastern U.S. The study used the original Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). A strength is its focus on novel correlates of body appreciation, finding that higher body appreciation is linked to a stronger desire to be different from others.
